facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance's REAP programme published a bid notice on 20 August 2026 for consultants to run a feasibility study for a sovereign AI-powered parliamentary system, with bids closing 14 September 2026.

UGA.note: A parliamentary system is not a sector's public system.
Only a feasibility study is tendered; no builder or site for the system is named.
